name: lustra
description: Lustra — the spatial operating system for detailing, PPF, tint & wrap shops (Next.js + Node.js + MongoDB)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix web start"
